custom.description:
desc

To set the parameters below, start with a `// @options:` line holding a JSON object of them, then write `code` from the next line. Leave the line out to use the defaults.
- `timeout` (integer): Optional time in milliseconds to wait for the script before moving it to the background (default 120000). The script keeps running in the background after that; it is never stopped. With `background: true` the call returns immediately instead.
- `background` (boolean): Run the script in the background and return immediately with its job ID (useful for long-running work). You will be notified when it completes. DO NOT poll for completion.
For example:
// @options: {"background": true}
